businessObject: MRP Run, Planned Order, Purchase Requisition, Stock/Requirements List, GMP Material with Shelf-Life Management

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access the "Stock/Requirements List" or run MRP via "Schedule MRP Runs" Fiori app.
The system considers the minimum remaining shelf-life requirement defined in the material master when proposing new procurement.
Batches that do not meet the minimum remaining shelf-life are excluded from available stock in the MRP availability check.
The system generates planned orders or purchase requisitions reflecting adjusted lead times where shelf-life constraints apply.
The planner can review and convert planning proposals directly from the Stock/Requirements List.
The system issues an exception message when existing stock is approaching the minimum shelf-life threshold.

HP.description: Access Stock/Requirements List for GMP material and run MRP for a plant with GMP materials having min shelf-life constraints, resulting in planned order/PR generation
Run MRP for GMP material with in-house production (Planned Order generation)
Run MRP for GMP material with external procurement (Purchase Requisition generation)

AP.description: Review and convert Planned Order to Production Order from Stock/Requirements List
Review and convert Purchase Requisition to Purchase Order from Stock/Requirements List

NEG.description: Run MRP for material without minimum remaining shelf-life configured (MHDRZ = 0) — system should process as standard MRP without shelf-life constraint
Run MRP for GMP material with existing batches all below minimum remaining shelf-life — system should exclude all batches and propose full replenishment

EDGE.description: Existing stock batch expiration date exactly equals minimum remaining shelf-life threshold — verify batch is excluded from availability
Existing stock batch expiration date is 1 day above minimum remaining shelf-life threshold — verify batch is included in availability
GMP material with total shelf life = minimum remaining shelf-life — verify system proposes procurement with adjusted lead time
EDGE.parameter: total shelf life vs min remaining shelf life

EDGE.description: Exception message triggered when batch remaining shelf life reaches minimum threshold exactly
Exception message triggered when batch remaining shelf life is 1 day below minimum threshold
